title: Page 92
transc:
Yorktown Apr 27 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
for shaffer this new nuptial pilgrim 
is very sadly in need of
a Commander if Ledlie is not
utterly worthless let me have him
he can not be as bad
as the present arrangement signed Smith
43 W  HN Snow


Ft Monroe Apr 27 1864 
H N Snow Yorktown
for Smith the pagan boats can
not make two much demon stray
shun towards mogul it will have
good effect period Vogdes will not
return to that command I will
be up tomorrow signs Chaff her
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe Apr 28 1864 
SH Beckwith Culpepper C. H.
for Jersey unity princess Clarke of my staff has
just returned from Abacus Wicks abacus Relieved from Walnut
Whinny that have gone to alba Webster Knox Florence
Geo D Sheldon
